title: Nvidia, Micron, AMD sink after SK Hynix results fail to impress, AI trade unwinds
excerpt: The semiconductor sector plummeted on Wednesday as SK Hynix reported a record second quarter operating profit, which fell short of lofty expectations.
content_html:
What happened: Semiconductor stocks fell on Wednesday as a record profit from memory maker SK Hynix (000660.KS, SKHY) failed to lift the sector, further unwinding the AI trade.

A hawkish interest rate hold from the Federal Reserve also weighed on sentiment.

The PHLX Semiconductor Index (^SOX) fell more than 5%, extending losses from the prior session. AI chip heavyweight Nvidia (NVDA) stock dropped more than 3%, while peer AMD (AMD) fell roughly 5%.

Memory and storage makers Micron (MU) and SanDisk (SNDK) pared losses, down 9% and 7%, respectively.

What's behind the move: SK Hynix reported a record second quarter operating profit, which rose 557% from a year earlier but fell short of lofty expectations, fueling investor concerns about whether AI-related spending can sustain its rapid pace.

US listed SK Hynix shares dropped more than 2%.

The earnings miss reflected a less favorable product mix rather than weakening demand for AI memory chips. Management reiterated that demand is expected to outpace supply through 2030.

The South Korean memory maker also said it plans to boost 2026 capital spending by roughly 50% to at least $31 billion as it ramps up AI memory production, raising investor concerns about potential overinvestment in AI infrastructure.

Barclays analysts cut their price target on US-listed stock to $300 from $330 following the results, but still maintain an Overweight rating. Susquehanna analysts also cut their price target on the South Korean shares.

What else you need to know: The move comes after SK Hynix tumbled more than 8% in the prior session amid concerns over rising competition, AI-related financing deals in the chip sector, and whether hyperscalers' massive AI investments will generate sufficient returns.

In Asia, investors once again dumped chip stocks such as Samsung (005930.KS) and SK Hynix, driving the KOSPI Composite (^KS11) down nearly 6% on Wednesday.

A strong debut from Chinese memory maker CXMT (688825.SS) in Shanghai this week also reignited concerns that expanding memory supply could pressure chip prices.

Semiconductor stocks have been at the center of the artificial intelligence trade this year, helping push the sector to record highs in June. Since then, chip stocks have fallen sharply as investors question whether hyperscalers' enormous AI spending plans will translate into adequate returns.

Last week, Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) stock plummeted after the tech giant announced it would raise its capital spending outlook as it builds out its AI infrastructure.

content_html_zh:
发生了什么：半导体股票周三下跌，因为存储器制造商 SK 海力士 (000660.KS, SKHY) 创纪录的利润未能提振该行业，进一步平仓了人工智能交易。

美联储强硬的利率维持也打压了市场情绪。

PHLX 半导体指数 (^SOX) 下跌超过 5%，延续前一交易日的跌幅。 AI芯片重量级企业英伟达 (NVDA) 股价下跌超过 3%，而同行 AMD (AMD) 股价下跌约 5%。

内存和存储制造商美光 (MU) 和闪迪 (SNDK) 减少了亏损，分别下跌 9% 和 7%。

此举背后的原因：SK海力士公布第二季度营业利润创历史新高，同比增长557%，但未达到高预期，引发投资者对人工智能相关支出能否维持快速增长的担忧。

美国上市的SK海力​​士股价下跌超过2%。

盈利低于预期反映的是产品组合不太有利，而不是人工智能存储芯片的需求减弱。 管理层重申，预计到 2030 年需求将超过供应。

这家韩国内存制造商还表示，随着人工智能内存产量的增加，该公司计划将 2026 年的资本支出增加约 50%，达到至少 310 亿美元，这引发了投资者对人工智能基础设施可能出现过度投资的担忧。

巴克莱分析师在业绩公布后将美国上市股票的目标价从 330 美元下调至 300 美元，但仍维持增持评级。 Susquehanna 分析师还下调了韩国股票的目标价。

您还需要知道什么：此举是在 SK Hynix 在前一交易日下跌超过 8% 之前发生的，原因是人们担心芯片行业的竞争加剧、人工智能相关的融资交易，以及超大规模企业的大规模人工智能投资是否会产生足够的回报。

在亚洲，投资者再次抛售三星(005930.KS)和SK海力士等芯片股，带动KOSPI综合指数(^KS11)周三下跌近6%。

中国内存制造商长鑫存储（688825.SS）本周在上海的强势亮相也再次引发了人们对内存供应扩大可能给芯片价格带来压力的担忧。

半导体股票今年一直处于人工智能交易的中心，帮助推动该行业在 6 月份创下历史新高。 此后，由于投资者质疑超大规模企业庞大的人工智能支出计划能否转化为足够的回报，芯片股大幅下跌。

上周，科技巨头 Alphabet（GOOG、GOOGL）宣布将提高其人工智能基础设施建设的资本支出前景后，该公司股价暴跌。
